201.description: Task created and placed in the pending pool.

Location.description: Path of the newly created task, e.g. `/tasks/{id}`.

type.description: The process path a task belongs to. REBIN tasks are not creatable through `POST /tasks` by HTTP-only callers in practice — they arrive via the WorkReleased Kafka event's rebin path (see the process-path catalogue) — but they exist in the task store and therefore appear in read-model responses alongside PICK/PACK/SLAM.
type.title: TaskType

fragile.description: Packing hint carried from task creation — see CreateTaskRequest.fragile. Does not affect claiming.

giftWrap.description: Read-only packing hint: true if this task's order was flagged for gift wrap at work-enqueue time. Unlike fragile, it has no HTTP ingestion path — it arrives only via WorkReleased.data.gift_wrap (see ADR-0011) and cannot be set through POST /tasks. Does not affect claiming or capability matching.

leaseStationId.description: The station currently holding the active claim, if any.

leaseExpiry.description: When the active claim's lease expires, if any.

400.description: The request body is malformed JSON, a required field is missing or empty, or a field value is invalid (e.g. a task type outside the TaskType enum). `instance` is omitted: this is a bare collection-create endpoint with no path segment identifying a specific resource.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error response, used for every error this API returns. See https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category. Does not need to resolve to a real page — it is an identifier, unique per distinct error category in this service.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code, per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced the error. Omitted for a validation error on a bare collection-create endpoint (`POST /tasks`, `POST /stations`) whose path has no segment identifying a specific resource.

schema.title: Problem

example.title: The request is malformed or missing a required field
example.detail: type must be one of PICK, PACK, SLAM, REBIN

500.description: An unexpected server-side failure (e.g. a repository or event-publisher error).
